metadata.title: Neon Knuckle - Full Track Export
metadata.composer_style: Yuzo Koshiro / Streets of Rage 2 (Go Straight / Back to the Industry) inspired House & Synthwave Chiptune
metadata.hardware_target: Sega Mega Drive / Genesis (Yamaha YM2612 FM + Texas Instruments SN76489 PSG)
metadata.key_signature: G Dorian (G - A - Bb - C - D - E - F) with parallel House chord planing

FM1_SlapBass.name: TX81Z / YM2612 Lately Solid House Bass

FM2_HouseStabs.name: M1 Organ / Brass Parallel House Chord Stab

FM3_LeadSynth.name: Streets of Rage Gritty Sync Saw Lead

FM4_SubPad.name: Warm Stereo Chorus FM Pad / Sub Doubler

FM6_DAC_Drums.name: Yuzo Koshiro Style Crunchy 909 Sample Kit

PSG2_Counter.name: Detuned Square Harmony / Octave Lead Delay

modes.OH: Open House Hat on off-beats (140ms decay, Vol 14)
modes.CR: White Noise Cymbal Crash (600ms decay, Vol 15)

Am7.name: A minor 7 (Dorian II - parallel house shift)

Bbmaj7.name: Bb major 7 (III chord - warm synthwave lift)

C9.name: C dominant 9 (Classic Dorian IV chord - bright & cool)

Ebmaj7#11.name: Eb major 7 #11 (Streets of Rage bridge tension)
